subject: general
question: Two resistances of 20 Ω each are connected in parallel. This combination is then connected in series with a third resistance of 20 Ω and a 3 V battery. The power supplied by the battery will be _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.30 W**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The equivalent resistance of two 20 Ω resistors in parallel: R_eq = (20 * 20) / (20 + 20) = 400 / 40 = 10 Ω
 
• The total resistance in the circuit: R_total = 10 Ω + 20 Ω = 30 Ω
 
• The two resistances of 20 Ω each are connected in parallel.
 
• The equivalent resistance of two 20 Ω resistors in parallel is 10 Ω.
 
• This equivalent resistance is then connected in series with a third resistance of 20 Ω.
 
• The total resistance in the circuit is therefore 30 Ω.
 
• The current through the circuit using Ohm's Law:

 I = V / R_total = 3V / 30Ω = 0.1 A
 
• The power supplied by the battery:

 P = V * I = 3V * 0.1A = 0.3 W

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Parallel and Series Resistors:

 
 
• In a parallel circuit, the total or equivalent resistance (R_eq) of resistors can be calculated using the formula:

 1/R_eq = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + ... + 1/Rn
 
• For two resistors R1 and R2 in parallel, the equivalent resistance is given by:

 R_eq = (R1 * R2) / (R1 + R2)
 
• In a series circuit, the total resistance (R_total) is the sum of the individual resistances:

 R_total = R1 + R2 + ... + Rn
 
 
 
• Ohm's Law:
 
 
• Ohm's Law states that the current (I) through a conductor between two points is directly proportional to the voltage (V) across the two points and inversely proportional to the resistance (R) between them:

 I = V / R
 
 
 
• Power Calculation:
 
 
• The power (P) supplied by the battery can be calculated using the formula:

 P = V * I
 
• Using Ohm's Law, we can substitute I = V / R into the power formula to get:

 P = V² / R
